Save at least 10% when buying a pack vs buying singles on downlights – 4 pack code 177GR.

This 4lite fixed LED slim downlight is a low-profile, circular lighting solution designed for installations with shallow ceiling voids. It delivers 1200 lumens of 3000K white light from its integrated 12W LED, making it suitable for various domestic and commercial settings such as kitchens, hallways, or offices. The downlight features a durable polycarbonate body and an IP20 rating, ensuring reliability for indoor use. Supplied pre-wired with 300mm of cable and an integral driver, installation is straightforward. Its non-dimmable, fixed design provides consistent illumination with a 115° beam angle, offering a long operational life of 54,000 hours.
b: Low-Profile Design Fits Shallow Ceiling Voids
